About Science Guru

Science Guru is a coaching institute dedicated to helping students build strong academic foundations through concept-based teaching, expert mentorship, regular testing, doubt solving and focused exam preparation.

We support students preparing for school examinations, board examinations and competitive examinations, at our Nikol and New Naroda branches in Ahmedabad.
